composition_resolution.description: Composition resolution: either 'auto' (derived from headset resolution) or 'WxH' (e.g., '2160x2160').

composition_scale.description: Composition scaling factor (0.1–1.0). Lower values improve performance at slight quality cost.

enable_composition.description: Enable GPU-accelerated composition for rendered output (required for VR headsets).

enable_vulkan_composition.description: Use Vulkan-based composition backend (requires compatible GPU/driver).

gpu_devices.description: List of GPU device paths to use for composition/rendering (ordered by preference).

description.description: Optional human-readable description (shown in config UI).

hmd_event_device.description: Path to HMD input event device (e.g., /dev/input/event5). Leave empty to auto-detect.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: none, error, warn, info, debug, trace.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent XR sessions (clients) allowed.

raw_input.description: Enable raw input device handling (e.g., for HTC Vive controllers). Disable only if using alternative input drivers.

runtime_path.description: Directory containing Monado XR runtime modules (e.g., 'openxr-monado-provider.so').

runtimes.description: List of XR runtime modules to load (by basename, without .so).

stderr.description: Output logs to stderr (useful when running manually in foreground for debugging).

syslog.description: Send log messages to system syslog (recommended for production services).
